upload.description: Upload is the image used for the repository upload stage.

container.description: Container holds the container images used for each pipeline stage.

name.description: Name is the name of the object-storage bucket.

repository.description: Repository is the Arch repository (database) name within the bucket.

bucket.description: Bucket describes the target object-storage bucket and repository.

name.description: Name is a human-readable identifier for the webhook (e.g. "ntfy").

type.description:
Type selects which kind of pipeline this webhook applies to: "build"
for the per-package pipelines, or "cleanup" for the daily
repository-cleanup pipeline.

when.description:
When selects which job outcome this webhook fires on: "on_success" or
"on_failure".

url.description: URL is the endpoint the notification is sent to.

name.description: Name is the HTTP header field name.

value.description: Value is the HTTP header field value (may contain variables).

items.description: Header is a single HTTP header name/value pair sent with a webhook request.

headers.description: Headers is the ordered list of HTTP headers to send with the request.

template.description: Template is the pass-through notification body template.

items.description: Webhook describes a single notification endpoint invoked when a pipeline completes.

webhook.description: Webhooks is the list of notification webhooks to invoke on completion.

name.description: Name is the AUR package name.

items.description: Package is a single AUR package entry to generate a pipeline for.

packages.description: Packages is the list of AUR packages to generate pipelines for.

description: Config is the top-level aur-pipelines configuration, loaded from a YAML file.
